loginDescription: Sign in to continue the selected requirement and retrieve your organisation’s saved profile.
loginInfoTitle: Your data stays in your account
loginInfo: After signing in, we load your profile from the server and return you to the selected content.
invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect. Check your details and try again.
forgotDescription: Enter your account email. If an account exists for that address, we’ll send a recovery link.
genericRecovery: If an account exists for that address, you’ll receive instructions to change the password.
resetDescription: Use at least 12 characters. This link can only be used once.
invalidReset: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new recovery link.
passwordChanged: Your password has changed. Sign in again.
verifyDescription: Confirming your email helps protect your account.
invalidVerification: This link is invalid or has expired.
missingToken: The link does not include a confirmation token.
